findings.summary: Backend-generated fallback labels are hardcoded English ('Unknown contact', 'Group chat · <suffix>' in backend/app/display_names.py:39,55) and are not localized through the console's zh-CN/zh-TW/en i18n system. The label is served as display_name from the API, so the frontend cannot translate it. Deliberate RND-129 design decision (raw IDs stay available as secondary data), not a regression.
findings.evidence: backend/app/display_names.py:39 'Unknown contact'; :55 'Group chat · {suffix}'; no i18n key indirection exists on the backend label path.
findings.required_fix: Out of RND-129 scope. Optional future ticket: route backend fallback labels through locale-aware strings once the console needs localized backend labels; do not expand scope now.

findings.summary: Group-chat fallback labels use only the last 6 chars of the roomid (_short_suffix, backend/app/display_names.py:21-25), so two distinct rooms sharing a 6-char suffix render identical 'Group chat · <suffix>' labels in the conversation list. Disambiguation remains possible via the title attribute, raw_id, room_raw_id, and conversation_id.
findings.evidence: backend/app/display_names.py:21-25,55; collision requires two roomids ending in the same 6 chars — low probability, non-blocking.
findings.required_fix: Out of RND-129 scope. Optional future improvement: lengthen the suffix or fall back to more of the roomid on collision; not required for this ticket.
